requirements.title: SELECTED_LOGICAL_KIND applies storage-size criterion and tie rule
requirements.definition: SELECTED_LOGICAL_KIND returns a logical kind with storage size at least BITS, or -1 with no such kind; among multiple matches it selects the smallest storage size and then the smallest kind value.
